# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 4 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 13 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Size — 8 tokens; Breakpoint — 2 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text, #f4f3ef);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text, #171614);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f4f3ef;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | #f4f3ef | #171614 | Primary ink: headings, body copy that must read, the active nav item, certification rules. 17.8:1 on bg (dark), 16.5:1 (light). |
| `--text-dim` | rgba(244,243,239,0.42) | rgba(23,22,20,0.5) | Secondary text anyone needs to read: job descriptions and dates, company names, project descriptions, contact copy, group labels, CV/Github/LinkedIn, photo country. FLAG: 3.8:1 on bg (dark) and 3.4:1 (light), under 4.5:1 for 12–14px text; fine at 24px+. |
| `--text-dimmer` | rgba(244,243,239,0.24) | rgba(23,22,20,0.32) | Only for things that are fine to miss: inactive nav links and the footer. Don't use it for content. FLAG: about 2:1 on bg in both themes. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #0a0a0a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #f6f4ef);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0a0a0a;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #0a0a0a | #f6f4ef | Page background. Near-black in dark, warm paper in light. Theme changes cross-fade it over .35s. |
| `--pill` | #1c1c1c | #ece9e1 | Fill for round controls (theme and language toggles) and the employer logo disc. Barely lifts from bg by design (1.2:1); the icon or label inside carries the contrast. |
| `--pill-hover` | #262626 | #e0dcd1 | Hover fill for pill controls, paired with a 1px lift. |
| `--focus` | #d9895f | #b5592f | The one hue. Focus rings (2px, 3px offset), text selection, and status signals such as the pulsing Pending dot. Use sparingly: one orange thing per view. 7.3:1 on bg (dark), 4.3:1 (light). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 500 96px/1 "DM Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-name); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `.name`, `--text-name` | 96px / 1, letter-spacing -0.01em | 500 | `display` | The two-line name block in About. Under 780px: clamp(56px, 16vw, 96px). |
| `hero` | `.hero`, `--text-hero` | 88px / 1.08, letter-spacing -0.01em | 500 | `display` | Intro heading. Fluid: clamp(38px, 6.5vw, 88px); max-width 1160px. |
| `job-title` | `.job-title`, `--text-job-title` | 32px / 1.15 | 700 | `display` | Role in a job entry, lowercase. Fluid: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px). |
| `list-row` | `.list-row`, `--text-list-row` | 30px / 1.2 | 400 | `display` | Certification rows. Fluid: clamp(18px, 2.4vw, 30px). |
| `wordmark` | `.wordmark`, `--text-wordmark` | 22px / 1.2 | 500 | `display` | The lowercase wordmark top-left. |
| `item-title` | `.item-title`, `--text-item-title` | 16px / 1.4 | 600 | `display` | Project names with the arrow-out icon. |
| `company` | `.company`, `--text-company` | 12px / 1.4 | 400 | `display` | Employer name above a job title, in text-dim. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 1.6 | 400 | `body` | All paragraph copy: job and project descriptions, contact text. text-dim, max width-prose. Nav links use this size too (inactive text-dimmer, active text at 500). |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 1.4 | 400 | `body` | Dates and city, group labels, links row, photo location, footer, toggle labels. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"DM Sans", sans-serif` |
| `body` | `--font-body` | `"Inter", sans-serif` |

## Spacing

Values as used in main.css; no formal scale yet (a move to steps of 8 has been proposed). Mobile (≤780px) swaps the 40px gutter for 24px.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-2);
```

### Tokens (13)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-2` | 2px | Nav link vertical padding; company-to-title gap. |
| `--space-8` | 8px | Nav link stack gap; separator dot spacing in captions; name-line bottom padding. |
| `--space-10` | 10px | Gap between toggle buttons; photo to caption row. |
| `--space-14` | 14px | Thumbnail grid gap and padding; date-to-city gap; mobile nav gap; certification label to list. |
| `--space-16` | 16px | Links row gap; footer padding. |
| `--space-22` | 22px | Logo disc to job text. |
| `--space-24` | 24px | About grid gap; mobile page gutter and top bar padding. |
| `--space-26` | 26px | Vertical padding of each job entry. |
| `--space-28` | 28px | Side nav: links to toggle group. |
| `--space-36` | 36px | Section label to content; desktop top bar padding. |
| `--space-40` | 40px | Desktop page gutter; side nav right offset. |
| `--space-60` | 60px | Gap between project columns. |
| `--space-70` | 70px | Vertical padding of every section. |
